newsitem.title: USA: Lukens sees Q3 loss between $0.26 and $0.33.
newsitem.headline: Lukens sees Q3 loss between $0.26 and $0.33.

text.p: Lukens Inc said on Monday that it would report a net loss for the third quarter between $0.26 and $0.32 per share, because of lower stainless steel prices.

"Sharply increased levels of low-priced, imported stainless steel continued to drive down U.S. prices during the quarter, resulting in an operating loss at our Stainless Group," said R.W. VanSant, Lukens' chairman and chief executive officer.
The company also said it expected to post a loss in the fourth quarter due to stainless steel prices in North America.
